source.title: Bonnie - Obsidian Claws
source.name: Bonnie
source.description: A Marksman skilled at using dark magic to weaken enemies and transforming into mist to avoid danger.

skills.name: Deathmark Arrow

description.raw: Bonnie fires magic arrows, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to each enemy twice. The magic arrrow deals 30% more damage to enemies afflicted by Aging and stuns them for 3 + 0.25 (SP-based)s.
active: Bonnie fires magic arrows, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to each enemy twice.
The magic arrrow deals 30% more damage to enemies afflicted by Aging and stuns them for 3 + 0.25 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Bonnie deals damage to all enemies, with increased damage and a stun effect on those afflicted by Aging.

skills.name: Decay's Reach

description.raw: When a battle starts, Bonnie casts the Aging magic on the rearmost enemy, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 30 until the battle ends. Bonnie prioritizes attacking this target afflicted by Aging. Whenever an allied hero deals magic damage to the enemy afflicted by aging, the effect is further enhanced, reducing their Haste by an extra 10. Each ally can only trigger the enhancement once, and the Aging magic can be enhanced up to 2 times. Once the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack, the afflicted enemy suffers a 30% + 3% (SP-based) reduction in their ATK and takes 100% damage every 1s.
active: When a battle starts, Bonnie casts the Aging magic on the rearmost enemy, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 30 until the battle ends.
Bonnie prioritizes attacking this target afflicted by Aging.

Once the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack, the afflicted enemy suffers a 30% + 3% (SP-based) reduction in their ATK and takes 100% damage every 1s.

skills.description_lite: Bonnie casts the Aging magic on the rearmost enemy, reducing their Haste. Whenever any other allied hero deals magic damage to the enemy afflicted by Aging, the effect is further enhanced.

skills.name: Nightfall Shift

description.raw: Bonnie transforms into a black mist, moving to a safe spot within 4 tiles and firing 6 arrows, each daling 35% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to an enemy. While in black mist form, Bonnie is invincible.
active: Bonnie transforms into a black mist, moving to a safe spot within 4 tiles and firing 6 arrows, each daling 35% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to an enemy.
While in black mist form, Bonnie is invincible.

skills.description_lite: Bonnie transforms into a black mist and moves to a safe spot.

skills.name: Blight Surge

description.raw: When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to the nearest 1 unafflicted enemy, dealing 260% (ATK-based) damage to each.
active: When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to the nearest 1 unafflicted enemy, dealing 260% (ATK-based) damage to each.

text: Increases the damage dealt by the spread of Aging to 270% (ATK-based)
When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to the nearest 2 unafflicted enemies.
Increases the damage dealt by the spread of Aging to 280% (ATK-based)

skills.description_lite: When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to an unafflicted enemy.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack on an enemy, their magic damage taken is increased by 10%, with an extra 20% increase for magic damage taken from Ultimates.
active: When the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack on an enemy, their magic damage taken is increased by 10%, with an extra 20% increase for magic damage taken from Ultimates.

skills.description_lite: When Aging reaches its maximum stack on an enemy, they take more magic damage.
